svg.title: Step 7 mockup 02: From the screen to a place in the session (player)
svg.text: 02 · From the screen to a place in the session (player)
Use case: an attendee sees the check-in QR or the schedule, opens the tournament in the hub and registers, solo or on a waiting list

g.text: Game art from the games catalogue
Four players per match, top two
go on. The crew enters results.
the crew may fill a team
If a team drops out before 19:15,
the first team on the list moves up
Team Epsilon moved up from the waiting list
Moved up from the waiting list
Tell us, so the next team gets it.
Team Alpha plays on without you;
its leader is told. The team keeps
its place while it has 5 players.

svg.text: The For you card leads; the list is one day at a time, times down the side, in the event's time zone (O4).
Format, places and the close time come from the session; the game art from the games catalogue (D15).
The timeline is the scheduler's, so the player sees the same times the screen and the bot use (U4).
Full sessions offer a waiting list; teams join it as a team or one by one (U5, U6).
Moving up is a push in the tournament topic and a For you card (D11).
Giving up a place frees it at once; after the close it needs the crew (U7).
Text fits its boxes: checked in headless Chromium (see the brief).
